summary: The page aligns well with RTL guidelines overall, but contains an overlapping tooltip obscuring a KPI metric and text collision within the data table pagination controls.

issues.title: Tooltip obscures metric value
issues.description: Tooltip container renders directly over the primary metric number in the conversion rate KPI card.
issues.evidence: Dark tooltip box overlaps and occludes the number beneath the card header.
issues.suggestion: Adjust tooltip placement offset to render clear of the metric value.

issues.title: Pagination text collision
issues.description: Table pagination footer displays unspaced, colliding English text labels.
issues.evidence: Bottom footer displays 'Rows per page0 of 9 row(s) selected.' without separation.
issues.suggestion: Add proper margin between pagination elements and localize label strings.
